records.name: Android Kick
records.character_source: Mira / Fu Customize Partner / Super Baby 2 Customize Partner
records.skill_description: A two-stage Strike Super in which the user performs a somersault and can follow with a diving kick; holding back changes the initial movement into a backward jump.
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 reference documents the initial flip and a second-input dive kick. Holding back changes the initial movement direction. Player testing also reports evasive utility during the flip, but exact invulnerability-frame claims are intentionally not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Skill Shop is the documented Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. Historical progression timing is not encoded as a fixed flag.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The flip provides movement/evasive utility and the second input produces the kick. Exact frame and matchup behavior is version-sensitive.
